title: 第627章 成功夺下两把仙钥第626章 激烈的仙钥争夺林轩等人开始行动
slug: 开局签到帝经我家族独断万古
lines: “行，那阵法的事就交给你了。”林轩点头道。
然后他转头看向圣天：“死猴，你的传送阵也能帮上忙，咱们争取在混乱中将那两把仙钥夺到手，然后立刻用传送阵脱离战场。”
圣天嘿嘿一笑：“小事一桩，包在本圣身上。”
之后叶昊天目光扫过下方的山谷，快速推算着阵法的范围，“不过你们要记住，以这里的范围和修士的数量，我的阵法最多只能困住那些修士三十息左右。”
“你们必须在这个时间内，成功抢到仙钥才行。”
闻言，林轩和叶冰凝他们也是面色认真了起来。
三十息，对于林轩和叶冰凝来说，足够做很多事情了。
“那就这么定了，一会昊天你们负责阵法，我和林轩负责抢夺仙钥。”
叶冰凝说完，然后看向林轩，“等阵法启动，你和我一起冲进去取仙钥，速战速决。”
林轩微微颔首：“自然没问题。”
计划已定，叶昊天立刻行动起来。
他带着几名叶家弟子，悄无声息地绕到山谷外围，开始布置阵法的节点。
他的动作极快，手法娴熟，每一次抬手打出一道阵印，都精准地落入指定的位置。
圣天也没有闲着，在山谷外围的几处隐蔽位置刻下了传送阵的基座，金色的符文在地面上闪烁了几下便隐没不见，只有极淡的空间波动在流转。
大约一盏茶的功夫，准备就绪。
叶昊天回到林轩身边，低声道：“阵法已经布置好了，随时可以启动。”
“传送阵也准备好了。”
圣天也凑了过来，“只要进入传送范围，本圣一个念头就能把咱们送走。”
林轩深吸一口气，目光紧紧地锁定着山谷中那两把悬浮的金色仙钥。
“那就准备好，时机一合适我们就动手。”
山谷中的混战依旧在持续。
二十万修士挤在并不算太宽阔的山谷中，互相厮杀、争夺、抢夺。
鲜血染红了地面，残肢断臂散落一地，空气中弥漫着浓郁的血腥味和仙力余波。
那两把仙钥此刻正被三个散修和一个大势力弟子缠斗在一起，四人互相牵制，谁也无法真正拿到仙钥。
就在这时。
“阵起！”
叶昊天低喝一声，双手猛然结印，朝着地面的某个节点打出一道法诀。
下一刻，整片山谷的地面瞬间亮起无数道银白色的光芒。
那些光芒如同蛛网一般迅速蔓延开来，在地面上组成了一道巨大的阵纹，将大半个山谷全部笼罩其中。
紧接着，无数道银白色的光柱从地面冲天而起，如同牢笼一般将那些修士困在其中。
光柱之间交织着密集的能量网，散发出强大的禁锢之力，让被困住的修士行动变得极其艰难。
“怎么回事？！”
“不好，是阵法，有人布了阵法！”
“该死！是谁？！”
那些被阵法笼罩的修士脸色大变，疯狂地攻击着那些银白色的光柱，试图将其击碎。
但叶昊天毕竟是半步王品仙阵师，他布下的困阵即便是半步仙王级别的强者，也不可能在短时间内破开。
林轩毫不犹豫，身形一闪，如同一道青色闪电冲入阵中。
叶冰凝紧随其后，手中冰蓝色长剑已经出鞘，剑身上凝结着一层寒冰，散发着刺骨的寒气。
两人一左一右，朝着那两把仙钥疾冲而去。
content_en:
"Okay, I'll leave the formation to you." Lin Xuan nodded.
Then he turned to look at Shengtian: "Dead monkey, your teleportation array can also help. Let's try to seize the two fairy keys in the chaos, and then use the teleportation array to leave the battlefield immediately."
Shengtian chuckled: "It's a small matter, I'll take care of it."
Afterwards, Ye Haotian glanced at the valley below and quickly calculated the range of the formation, "But you must remember that with the range here and the number of monks, my formation can only trap those monks for about thirty breaths at most."
"You must successfully grab the Immortal Key within this time."
Hearing this, Lin Xuan and Ye Binning also looked serious.
Thirty breaths was enough for Lin Xuan and Ye Binning to do a lot of things.
"Then it's settled. Haotian and you will be in charge of the formation in a while, and Lin Xuan and I will be in charge of snatching the Immortal Key."
Ye Binning finished speaking, and then looked at Lin Xuan, "When the formation is activated, you and I will rush in together to get the Immortal Key, and we will fight quickly."
Lin Xuan nodded slightly: "Of course it's no problem."
The plan was decided, and Ye Haotian took action immediately.
He took several Ye family disciples and quietly walked around the outside of the valley and began to arrange the nodes of the formation.
His movements were extremely fast and his techniques were skillful. Every time he raised his hand to create a formation seal, it landed exactly in the designated position.
Shengtian was not idle either. He carved the bases of the teleportation array in several hidden locations outside the valley. The golden runes flickered on the ground for a few times and then disappeared, leaving only very faint spatial fluctuations circulating.
It takes about a cup of tea and it's ready.
Ye Haotian returned to Lin Xuan and whispered: "The formation has been arranged and can be activated at any time."
"The teleportation array is also ready."
Shengtian also came over, "As long as we enter the teleportation range, I can send us away with just one thought."
Lin Xuan took a deep breath and fixed his eyes tightly on the two golden fairy keys suspended in the valley.
"Then get ready, we will take action when the time is right."
…
The melee in the valley continues.
Two hundred thousand monks crowded into the not-too-wide valley, fighting, fighting, and robbing each other.
Blood dyed the ground red, broken limbs and broken arms were scattered on the ground, and the air was filled with the strong smell of blood and the aftermath of the immortal power.
The two Immortal Keys are currently being fought together by three casual cultivators and a disciple from a large force. The four of them are restraining each other, and no one can really get the Immortal Key.
Just then.
"Array up!"
Ye Haotian gave a low shout, formed seals with his hands suddenly, and shot a magic spell towards a certain node on the ground.
The next moment, the entire valley ground lit up with countless silvery white lights.
Those lights spread quickly like a spider web, forming a huge array on the ground, covering most of the valley.
Immediately afterwards, countless silver-white light pillars shot up from the ground into the sky, trapping the monks in them like a cage.
A dense energy network is intertwined between the light pillars, exuding a powerful confinement force, making it extremely difficult for the trapped monks to move.
"What's going on?!"
"No, it's the formation. Someone has set up the formation!"
"Damn! Who is it?!"
The faces of the monks enveloped by the formation changed greatly, and they frantically attacked the silver-white light pillars, trying to break them.
But Ye Haotian is a Half-Step Immortal King-level master after all, and the trap he has set up cannot be broken through in a short time even by a half-step Immortal King-level expert.
"Let's go!"
Lin Xuan did not hesitate, and with a flash of his body, he rushed into the formation like a bolt of cyan lightning.
Ye Binning followed closely behind, the ice-blue sword in his hand already unsheathed. A layer of ice condensed on the sword, exuding a biting cold air.
The two of them rushed towards the two immortal keys, one on the left and the other on the right.
